body:
Rowan Digital Infrastructure, a developer of build-to-suit data center campuses for hyperscale cloud and AI customers, said on Thursday it has secured about $1.5 billion of corporate financing to fund work across its 5.5 GW US project pipeline [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). The package combines a $600 million upsize of its term loan with Apterra Infrastructure Capital, which takes that facility to $900 million from the $300 million first arranged in September 2025, and the company's first syndicated bank facilities: a $590 million revolving credit facility and a $355 million letter of credit facility, both led by Citibank [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/)[[2]](https://rowan.digital/rowan-secures-1-2-billion-for-hyperscale-data-center-expansion-and-sustainability-initiatives/).

Unlike Rowan's earlier project loans, which each financed a single campus, these sit at the company level. Rowan says the revolver gives it money to start development without returning to the market for each site, and the letter of credit facility covers collateral such as utility interconnection deposits and equipment vendor commitments, two cash demands that arrive early in a data center project [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). Accordion features allow the revolver to rise to $2 billion and the letter of credit facility to $1 billion, subject to terms [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/).

Citibank, Mizuho, MUFG, Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Societe Generale, SMBC and Huntington National Bank are in the revolver and letter of credit syndicate, with Citi as left lead arranger, bookrunner and administrative agent [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). Apterra provides the term loan [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/).

Rowan, founded in November 2020 and backed by Quinbrook and Blackstone, says it has more than 1.2 GW contracted to large technology companies, which it does not name, and has raised more than $8 billion from more than 40 lenders over the past 18 months [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). Its project financings include nearly $3 billion in May for the 300 MW Temple campus, $550 million in February for the 300 MW Cinco campus in Medina County, Texas, and $925 million for the third phase of its Bauxite campus in Frederick County, Maryland [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). "Demand for digital infrastructure financing continues to accelerate," Apterra co-chief executives Ralph Cho and Michael Pantelogianis said [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/).

p: 하이퍼스케일 클라우드·AI 고객을 위한 build-to-suit 데이터센터 캠퍼스 개발사 Rowan Digital Infrastructure는 목요일, 미국 내 5.5GW 규모 프로젝트 파이프라인 전반의 사업 자금을 마련하기 위해 약 15억 달러의 기업금융(corporate financing)을 확보했다고 밝혔다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). 이번 패키지는 Apterra Infrastructure Capital과의 텀론(term loan)을 6억 달러 증액한 부분과, 회사 최초의 신디케이트 은행 대출인 5억9,000만 달러 규모 회전신용공여(RCF)와 3억5,500만 달러 규모 신용장(letter of credit) 한도로 구성된다. 텀론은 2025년 9월 처음 조성된 3억 달러에서 9억 달러로 늘어났고, RCF와 신용장 한도는 모두 Citibank가 주도했다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/)[[2]](https://rowan.digital/rowan-secures-1-2-billion-for-hyperscale-data-center-expansion-and-sustainability-initiatives/).

캠퍼스 한 곳씩을 대상으로 했던 Rowan의 기존 프로젝트 대출과 달리, 이번 대출은 회사 차원(company level)에서 이뤄졌다. Rowan은 RCF 덕분에 사이트마다 시장을 다시 찾지 않고도 개발에 착수할 자금을 확보하게 됐다고 설명했다. 신용장 한도는 전력 계통 연계(utility interconnection) 보증금과 장비 공급업체 약정 같은 담보를 충당하는데, 이 두 가지는 데이터센터 프로젝트 초기에 발생하는 현금 수요다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). 어코디언(accordion) 조항에 따라 조건 충족 시 RCF는 20억 달러까지, 신용장 한도는 10억 달러까지 늘어날 수 있다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/).

RCF·신용장 신디케이트에는 Citibank, Mizuho, MUFG, Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Societe Generale, SMBC, Huntington National Bank가 참여했으며, Citi가 left lead arranger, bookrunner 겸 administrative agent를 맡았다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). 텀론은 Apterra가 제공한다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/).

2020년 11월 설립돼 Quinbrook과 Blackstone의 투자를 받고 있는 Rowan은 사명을 밝히지 않은 대형 기술 기업들과 1.2GW 이상의 계약을 체결했으며, 지난 18개월간 40곳 넘는 대주단으로부터 80억 달러 이상을 조달했다고 밝혔다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). 프로젝트 파이낸싱으로는 5월 300MW 규모 Temple 캠퍼스에 대한 30억 달러 가까운 조달, 2월 텍사스주 Medina County 소재 300MW 규모 Cinco 캠퍼스에 대한 5억5,000만 달러, 메릴랜드주 Frederick County 소재 Bauxite 캠퍼스 3단계에 대한 9억2,500만 달러 조달이 있다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/). Apterra의 공동 CEO인 Ralph Cho와 Michael Pantelogianis는 "디지털 인프라 금융에 대한 수요는 계속 가속화되고 있다"고 말했다 [[1]](https://www.powermag.com/rowan-digital-infrastructure-secures-1-5-billion-in-financing-for-hyperscale-development-platform/).
중요한 기사를 이메일 한 통에 담았습니다. 무료이며 언제든 구독을 해지할 수 있습니다.
전체 리서치와 분석, 10년 이상의 재무 자료, 13F 보유 현황 및 AI 인프라 데이터를 제공하며, 팔로우하는 기업의 공시 알림도 받아볼 수 있습니다.
